verdict.rationale: Running an email marketing SaaS headlessly or in CI through an API or CLI is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API, CLI, or CI integration. The marketing-automation workflows and no-code app integrations it does mention are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
